subject.title: refactor(zalouser): share offset-preserving text chunk ranges

question: Should `chunkTextRanges` and its two public types become a supported `plugin-sdk/text-chunking` contract for this release?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but accepting a new public Plugin SDK export creates a long-lived compatibility commitment that automation should not choose independently.

options.title: Accept the public helper
options.body: Land the narrow generic API and Zalouser migration with the existing docs, baseline, parity, and surrogate-boundary coverage.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Retain the shared implementation inside core or Zalouser without exposing a new third-party Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the public helper
recommendation.body: Land the narrow generic API and Zalouser migration with the existing docs, baseline, parity, and surrogate-boundary coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged adjacent shared Zalouser outbound work and are the strongest available owner for the SDK-contract inclusion choice.
